Tariff and non-tariff notifications, circulars and instructions from the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs. These change duty rates, procedures, valuations (tariff values) and filing systems like SCMTR.
Notifications amend import and export policy (ITC-HS), public notices amend the Handbook of Procedures, and trade notices explain procedures and systems. Circulars clarify specific cases.
Each custom house and ICD issues public notices on local procedures: examination, manifests, holds, timings and system changes. They matter for the port or ICD you clear at.
Our summaries help you spot what matters quickly. Only the official document is authoritative, and dates can be extended or changed by later notices.

Implementation of the Sea Cargo Manifest and Transshipment Regulations (SCMTR), 2018

The old export manifest messages will be switched off zone by zone, with SCMTR messages becoming mandatory: Thiruvananthapuram from 16 Nov 2026, Chennai 7 Dec, Kolkata 14 Dec, and Delhi, Ahmedabad (incl. Mundra) and Mumbai zones from 6 Jan 2027, with the transition complete by 31 Jan 2027. Custodians, terminals and trans-shippers must move to SCMTR-compliant software. No penal action during this implementation phase.

The Sea Cargo Manifest and Transshipment (Fourth Amendment) Regulations, 2026

Amends the SCMTR, 2018 (the rules for sea cargo manifests and transshipment). It is read together with Circular 47/2026-Customs, which sets the zone-wise dates for moving export manifest filing to SCMTR.
Official copy: CBIC Tax Information Portal
Mandatory filing under SCMTR, 2018: discontinuation of Supplementary IGM/EGM filing with effect from 12.08.2026
For ICD Tughlakabad, supplementary IGM and EGM filings in the old format are discontinued; manifest amendments must be filed under SCMTR.
